subject.title: feat(auto-reply): add "commentary" verbose level for narration-only progress

question: Should OpenClaw permanently add `commentary` as a fourth globally persisted verbose level with narration-only semantics across all clients and channels?
rationale: The protocol supports the implementation, but this expands a long-lived public config and session contract and intentionally changes which operational details users see; source inspection cannot determine maintainer product intent.

options.title: Sponsor global preset
options.body: Approve the permanent semantics and continue after a clean rebase, compatibility proof, and completed live behavior evidence.

options.title: Keep existing levels
options.body: Retain `off|on|full` and limit commentary and tool separation to existing channel streaming controls and focused channel repairs.

recommendation.title: Sponsor global preset
recommendation.body: Approve the permanent semantics and continue after a clean rebase, compatibility proof, and completed live behavior evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged history most directly owns the durable commentary and shared progress architecture affected by this contract decision.
